Physical_Interpretation: Effective vertical ice column thickness compressed to pure glacier ice density (rho_i = 917 kg/m^3)
BedMachine_V4_1_Origin: Directly reported as "thickness" variable in NetCDF (already firn-corrected)
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: Governs depth-integrated membrane stress tensor int(2 nu eps_dot) dz = 2 H_ice nu eps_dot and driving stress prefactor rho_i g H_ice
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: Governs shear creep flux: q_SIA proportional to H_ice^(n+2)
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: PRIMARY FLOTATION VARIABLE: Flotation threshold is rho_i * H_ice <= -rho_w * b
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: PRIMARY MASS VARIABLE: M_grounded = integral (rho_i * H_ice) dA
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: Must NOT be directly compared to raw REMA / laser altimetry without adding FAC
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: BedMachine "thickness" is ALREADY H_ice. NEVER subtract FAC from it (would double-subtract firn air)!

Physical_Interpretation: Total equivalent vertical air column trapped within the unsaturated snow/firn pore space
BedMachine_V4_1_Origin: Reported as "firn" variable in NetCDF (derived from RACMO / Ligtenberg model)
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: DOES NOT ENTER SSA: Firn air carries zero horizontal deviatoric stress and negligible shear resistance
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: DOES NOT ENTER SIA: No viscous creep occurs in unsaturated air pore volume
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: Indirect: Represents geometric displacement between top of snow and solid ice equivalent datum
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: EXCLUDED FROM MASS: Firn air mass is zero; must never be multiplied by rho_i in mass ledger
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: PRIMARY SURFACE RECONSTRUCTION: Added to s_ice to reconstruct physical REMA snow surface: s_physical = s_ice + FAC
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: FAC is a geometric correction only. It belongs in surface elevation reconstruction, never in mass accounting.

Physical_Interpretation: Total physical distance from bedrock/subglacial interface to the physical snow surface
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: Secondary: Controls total physical column height; deviatoric stress is zero in upper FAC layer
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: Secondary: Vertical shear is concentrated in bottom dense solid ice layer
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: Bulk density formulation: rho_bar * H_geom = rho_i * H_ice (produces identical mass threshold)
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: DOES NOT ENTER SOLID MASS: Using H_geom in mass ledger falsely counts air as ice mass
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: Governs geometric radar sounding echo delay and physical snow-air interface
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: Do not confuse H_geom with H_ice. Always integrate continuity over H_ice.

Physical_Interpretation: Subglacial bedrock topography or open sub-ice ocean bathymetric elevation relative to EIGEN-6C4 geoid
BedMachine_V4_1_Origin: Directly reported as "bed" variable in NetCDF
Mathematical_Definition_or_Relation: b = s_ice - H_ice (enforced by mass conservation and IFPA in BedMachine)
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: Governs basal traction application boundary z = b(x,y) and subglacial bed slope grad(b)
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: Governs lower boundary condition for vertical shear deformation
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: Governs water column depth: d = max(0, -b); controls hydrostatic seawater pressure at base
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: Fixed lower boundary of grounded ice column; volume above flotation depends on b
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: Unaffected by firn air content; invariant between geometric and ice-equivalent datums
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: Bed elevation b is identical in both geometric and ice-equivalent systems.

Physical_Interpretation: Surface elevation datum corresponding to compressed solid ice column (lowered by FAC)
BedMachine_V4_1_Origin: Directly reported as "surface" variable in NetCDF
Mathematical_Definition_or_Relation: s_ice = b + H_ice (grounded) or s_ice = (1 - rho_i/rho_w) * H_ice (floating)
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: PRIMARY DRIVING STRESS VARIABLE: Horizontal pressure gradient is rho_i g H_ice grad(s_ice)
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: PRIMARY DRIVING STRESS VARIABLE: Surface slope grad(s_ice) drives vertical shear creep
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: Defines freeboard elevation of floating ice equivalent column
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: Used to verify internal consistency: s_ice - b == H_ice across all grounded cells
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: Represents the ice-equivalent datum; lower than REMA by exact amount of FAC
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: When computing driving stress grad(s), use s_ice to avoid spurious firn-density gradient artifacts.

Physical_Interpretation: Actual top of snowpack measured by optical and laser altimetry (REMA, ICESat-2, CryoSat-2)
BedMachine_V4_1_Origin: Reconstructed from BedMachine via s_ice + firn; corresponds to original REMA mosaic
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: DOES NOT ENTER SSA: Spatial gradients of s_physical contain localized firn compaction noise
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: DOES NOT ENTER SIA: Internal shearing is driven by ice-equivalent overburden gradient
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: Controls physical ocean freeboard height: freeboard = s_physical for floating shelf
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: Does not enter grounded solid mass accounting
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: PRIMARY ALTIMETRY TARGET: Satellite altimetry dh/dt measures rate of change of s_physical
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: Before comparing model surface changes to altimetry, convert via ds_physical/dt = ds_ice/dt + dFAC/dt.

Physical_Interpretation: Discrete integer spatial classification: 0=ocean, 1=ice-free land, 2=grounded ice, 3=floating ice, 4=non-Antarctica
BedMachine_V4_1_Origin: Directly reported as "mask" variable in NetCDF
Mathematical_Definition_or_Relation: M = 2 if grounded ice; M = 3 if floating ice shelf; M = 0 if open water / calving bay
Role_in_SSA_Stress_Balance: Determines basal traction: beta_b > 0 if M=2 (grounded); beta_b = 0 if M=3 (floating)
Role_in_SIA_Stress_Balance: Active only over grounded ice (M=2); inactive on floating shelves (M=3)
Role_in_Hydrostatic_Flotation: Defines 2D grounding line contour Gamma_GL as interface between M=2 and M=3
Role_in_Grounded_Mass_Accounting: Defines spatial integration domain for grounded volume: Omega_grounded = { (x,y) | M(x,y) == 2 }
Role_in_Surface_Altimetry_Comparison: Distinguishes land ice thinning from floating shelf melting
Double_Counting_Prevention_Rule: STRICT RULE: Mask migration must be strictly coupled to flotation criterion with discrete mass reclassification.
